answer: To resist Sybil attacks an AI-agent economy can require every identity to maintain a continuous thread of unique computational proofs that are expensive to generate in parallel. An attacker must expend real CPU or GPU cycles for each fake account and cannot cheaply multiply identities without proportional resource cost. This creates a natural river of verifiable activity that genuine agents follow while Sybils are stranded%3B only sustained useful work in this meadow of shared computation earns lasting attestation.
